rule_text: Card testing. Three or more small online authorizations on one card within an hour, followed by a larger purchase: recommend `DECLINE_TRANSACTION` and `STEP_UP_AUTH`. If a purchase over $100 has already cleared, recommend `BLOCK_CARD`.

parse.note: the first later online purchase at or above the small cap

parse.why_not_in_text: the rule says 'small' without a number
the rule says 'followed by' without a time limit

sql_template: WITH small AS ( SELECT id, TransactionID, card_id, customer_id, ts, amt FROM txc WHERE channel = '{channel}' AND amt < {small_max} AND ts <= '{as_of}' {card_filter} ), win AS ( SELECT *, count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY card_id ORDER BY ts RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL {window_min} MINUTE PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS n_in_window FROM small ), run_end AS (SELECT card_id, ts AS end_ts FROM win WHERE n_in_window >= {min_small}), followed AS ( SELECT DISTINCT r.card_id, r.end_ts FROM run_end r JOIN txc b ON b.card_id = r.card_id AND b.channel = '{channel}' AND b.amt >= {small_max} AND b.ts > r.end_ts AND b.ts <= least(r.end_ts + INTERVAL {lookahead_h} HOUR, TIMESTAMP '{as_of}') ), members AS ( SELECT s.id, s.card_id, s.customer_id, s.ts, s.amt, 'small_auth' AS role FROM followed f JOIN small s ON s.card_id = f.card_id AND s.ts BETWEEN f.end_ts - INTERVAL {window_min} MINUTE AND f.end_ts UNION SELECT id, card_id, customer_id, ts, amt, 'larger_purchase' FROM ( SELECT b.id, b.card_id, b.customer_id, b.ts, b.amt FROM followed f JOIN txc b ON b.card_id = f.card_id AND b.channel = '{channel}' AND b.amt >= {small_max} AND b.ts > f.end_ts AND b.ts <= least(f.end_ts + INTERVAL {lookahead_h} HOUR, TIMESTAMP '{as_of}') QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY f.card_id, f.end_ts ORDER BY b.ts, b.TransactionID) = 1 ) ) SELECT id, card_id, customer_id, ts::VARCHAR, amt, role, (role = 'larger_purchase' AND amt > {block_over}) AS cleared_over_block FROM members ORDER BY card_id, ts, id
